Details 
 The Hunton Tee delivers timeless western style with a clean, understated edge. Featuring the horn logo outlined in a badge-inspired design, this men’s western logo tee offers a subtle nod to heritage while maintaining a modern, everyday look.
 Crafted from a soft and durable 60% cotton and 40% polyester blend, the Hunton Tee provides lightweight comfort with lasting structure. The men’s regular fit creates a classic silhouette that works effortlessly on its own or layered, pairing naturally with premium western denim, especially styles from the men’s jeans collection.
 Simple, refined, and rooted in western tradition, the Hunton Tee is built for everyday wear without sacrificing identity.
 Fabric:60% Cotton | 40% Polyester
 Fit: Men's regular fit
 Details: Soft hand print, pigment washed
